answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 40797 Country: India Title: I am an MBA student living in Mumbai. Due to my busy schedule nowadays I am unable to read the holy Quran Question: I am an MBA student living in Mumbai. Due to my busy schedule nowadays I am unable to read the holy Quran. I heard about softcopy of Quran from somewhere. But I want to know that is it right to keep the holy Quran in mobile phones? Please help me by solving my query. Answer ID: 40797 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1345/850/L=1433) It is allowable to store the holy Quran in mobile. However, if songs etc are downloaded in the memory then in such memory the holy Quran should not be stored. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
